name: closure counter
code:
def make_counter():
    n = 0
    def inc():
        nonlocal n
        n += 1
        return n
    return inc
c1 = make_counter()
c2 = make_counter()
print(c1(), c1(), c2(), c1())

name: global keyword battery
code:
count = 0
items = []
def record(v):
    global count
    count += 1
    items.append(v)
    return count
record('a')
record('b')
print(count, items)

name: nested function nonlocal layers
code:
def outer():
    x = 'o'
    def middle():
        nonlocal x
        def inner():
            nonlocal x
            x = 'i'
        inner()
        return x
    r = middle()
    return x, r
print(outer())
